Network Name: Rails to Trails of Wayne County Trail System
Ownership: Rails to Trails of Wayne County (501(c)(3) nonprofit)
Governance: Rails to Trails of Wayne County
Description: Network of paved rail-trails in Wayne County operated by Rails to Trails of Wayne County nonprofit. Currently includes County Line Trail (6.7 mi) and Heartland Trail (3.7 mi built). Network will grow as additional Heartland Trail segments open.
Identity Notes: Sippo Valley Trail (T7-002) and Holmes County Trail (T7-004) held — multi-county.
